name: Bradley McKnight
summary: Totally blind singer-songwriter, music producer and rapper from Nottinghamshire, and the founder of Why Struggle Music.
image_alt: Bradley, seen from behind, sits at a desk in his home studio wearing headphones. One hand is on a keyboard and the other is on a laptop. A poster on the wall reads What is life without music.
